source_refs.note: Exercise 9.2, Question 7 (book p. 272); the book prints no answers for Exercise 9.2; answers checked with sympy and the solution book

blocks.explanation:
Teen \(\sin^{-1}\) terms jama ho rahe hain, aur jawab \(\frac{\pi}{2}\) hai.
Diya kya hai? \(\sin^{-1}\frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}\), \(\sin^{-1}\frac{1}{\sqrt{5}}\), \(\sin^{-1}\frac{1}{\sqrt{10}}\).
Find kya karna hai? Jama \(\frac{\pi}{2}\) dikhana hai.
Rule kaunsa? Pehla term mashhoor angle \(\frac{\pi}{4}\) hai; baqi do ko formula (i) se jorenge.
Plan: agar baqi do ka jama bhi \(\frac{\pi}{4}\) nikle to kul \(\frac{\pi}{4} + \frac{\pi}{4} = \frac{\pi}{2}\).
steps:
Diya gaya: \(\sin^{-1}\frac{1}{\sqrt{2}} + \sin^{-1}\frac{1}{\sqrt{5}} + \sin^{-1}\frac{1}{\sqrt{10}}\).
Maloom karna (prove): jama \(\frac{\pi}{2}\) hai.
Tareeqa: pehla term ek jaana pehchana angle hai. Aakhri do ko formula (i) \(\sin^{-1}x + \sin^{-1}y = \sin^{-1}\left(x\sqrt{1-y^{2}} + y\sqrt{1-x^{2}}\right)\) se jorenge, jahan \(x = \frac{1}{\sqrt{5}}\), \(y = \frac{1}{\sqrt{10}}\). Kaunse do terms jorne hain, yeh samajhdari se chunna hai: mashhoor angle ko alag rakhna faidemand hai.

Mashhoor angle
\[\sin^{-1}\tfrac{1}{\sqrt{2}} = \tfrac{\pi}{4}\]
Kyun: \(\sin 45^{\circ} = \frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}\), yani \(\sin\frac{\pi}{4} = \frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}\), aur \(\frac{\pi}{4}\) principal range \(\left[-\frac{\pi}{2}, \frac{\pi}{2}\right]\) mein hai.
Mashhoor angles ki values (\(\frac{\pi}{6}, \frac{\pi}{4}, \frac{\pi}{3}\)) zubani yaad hon to aise sawal mein waqt bachta hai.

Baqi do ke square roots
\[\sqrt{1-x^{2}} = \sqrt{1 - \tfrac{1}{5}} = \tfrac{2}{\sqrt{5}}\]
\[\sqrt{1-y^{2}} = \sqrt{1 - \tfrac{1}{10}} = \tfrac{3}{\sqrt{10}}\]
\[x^{2} + y^{2} = \tfrac{1}{5} + \tfrac{1}{10} = \tfrac{3}{10} \le 1\]
Kyun: \(x^{2} = \frac{1}{5}\), is liye \(1 - x^{2} = \frac{4}{5}\) aur root \(\frac{2}{\sqrt{5}}\). Isi tarah \(1 - y^{2} = \frac{9}{10}\) aur root \(\frac{3}{\sqrt{10}}\). Formula (i) ki shart bhi poori hai.

Formula (i) lagayein
\[\sin^{-1}\tfrac{1}{\sqrt{5}} + \sin^{-1}\tfrac{1}{\sqrt{10}}\]
\[= \sin^{-1}\left(\tfrac{1}{\sqrt{5}}\cdot\tfrac{3}{\sqrt{10}} + \tfrac{1}{\sqrt{10}}\cdot\tfrac{2}{\sqrt{5}}\right)\]
\[= \sin^{-1}\left(\tfrac{3}{\sqrt{50}} + \tfrac{2}{\sqrt{50}}\right) = \sin^{-1}\tfrac{5}{\sqrt{50}}\]
Kyun: dono products mein neeche \(\sqrt{5}\cdot\sqrt{10} = \sqrt{50}\) aata hai, is liye seedha jama ho gaye.
Dhyan dein: \(x\) ko \(y\) wale root \(\frac{3}{\sqrt{10}}\) se, aur \(y\) ko \(x\) wale root \(\frac{2}{\sqrt{5}}\) se multiply karna hai.

Saaf karein
\[\tfrac{5}{\sqrt{50}} = \tfrac{5}{5\sqrt{2}} = \tfrac{1}{\sqrt{2}}\]
\[\sin^{-1}\tfrac{1}{\sqrt{2}} = \tfrac{\pi}{4}\]
Kyun: \(\sqrt{50} = \sqrt{25 \times 2} = 5\sqrt{2}\), aur 5 cancel ho gaya. Dilchasp baat: in do angles ka jama bhi \(\frac{\pi}{4}\) nikla.
Dhyan dein: \(\sqrt{50}\) ko simplify karna mat bhooliye, warna \(\frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}\) pehchana nahi jata.

Sab jama karein
\[\text{L.H.S} = \tfrac{\pi}{4} + \tfrac{\pi}{4} = \tfrac{\pi}{2} = \text{R.H.S}\]
Kyun: pehla term \(\frac{\pi}{4}\) aur baqi do ka jora bhi \(\frac{\pi}{4}\).

Tasdeeq
\[0.7854 + 0.4636 + 0.3218 = 1.5708\]
\[\tfrac{\pi}{2} \approx 1.5708\ \checkmark\]
Kyun: calculator (radian mode) se teeno angles jama kiye, \(\frac{\pi}{2}\) aaya.
Yeh bhi ghor kijiye ke teeno angles mil kar bilkul \(90^{\circ}\) bana rahe hain: \(45^{\circ} + 26.57^{\circ} + 18.43^{\circ} = 90^{\circ}\).
